notes: Both conjectures true: a(n) = A014644(n+2) - A014644(n+1) for n >= 2, and row n ends in A014644(n+1) (row 1 in A014644(1)). Levine rows R_k (k>=2) are prefixes of Golomb's sequence; induction S_n + 1 = |R_{n+1}| gives R_{n+1} = R_n ++ row n. Lean: A113676_differences, A113676_final_one, A113676_final; golomb_unique identifies the Lean Golomb sequence with any sequence meeting the A001462 definition. Outside Lean: none beyond reading the definitions.

sources.cite: J. Claes, R. Miyamoto, Golombic and Levine sequences, arXiv:2602.10992 (2026)
